description: Approximate the pages linking to a competitor using free web-search signals (domain mentions and brand mentions). De-duplicates by host and excludes the competitor's own domain. Not a complete backlink index — a free, directional starting point for prospecting.

competitorUrl.description: Competitor's URL or domain (e.g. https://competitor.com or competitor.com).

name: find_competitor_link_sources
title: Find competitor link sources
